gravity.line: But you come back with gravity
stanza: Out in the park, we watch the sunset
Talkin' on a rusty swing set
After a while, you went quiet
And I got mean
I'm always pushin' you away from me
But you come back with gravity
And when I call, you come home
A bird in your teeth
Sin and gravity
Drag me down to sleep
To dream of trains across the sea
Trains across the sea

gravity.songTitle: Let’s Not Shit Ourselves (To Love and to Be Loved)
gravity.line: I've seen a child, he's caught in the sad trap of gravity
stanza: Well, the animals laugh from the dark of the wilderness
A baby cries hard in an apartment complex
As I pass in a car buried under the influence
The city's driving me out of my mind
I've seen a child, he's caught in the sad trap of gravity
He falls from the lowest branch of the apple tree
And lands in the grass, and weeps for his dignity
Next time, he will not aim so high
Yeah, next time, neither will I

gravity.songTitle: The Closer I Get to You
gravity.line: Pulling closer, sweet as the gravity
stanza: The closer I get to you
A feeling comes over me (Me, too)
Pulling closer, sweet as the gravity
The closer I get to you

gravity.line: 'Til I lose my sense of gravity
stanza: Here I go and I don't know why
I spin so ceaselessly
'Til I lose my sense of gravity
